description: Start a thread with its first comment. Pin it to a node (nodeId: the pin sits at its top-right corner and follows the node) or to a world point; one of the two is required. Signed with your agent name. Takes no undo step.

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

nodeId.description: Node to pin to (see get_document); without pageId the thread goes on the page holding it.

pageId.description: Page to act on (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode. A repo map page is read from the code: a change for it lands on the map's drawing, which the editor shows.

point.description: World position of the pin; wins over the node corner when both are given.

name: start_thread
title: Start a thread
